reason: We have to replace E-Golf4U and I can't put 950 members on a system built by two people that isn't live at a single club yet. The pilot costing nothing is nice, but the board's time and the members' patience aren't free, and I can't afford to switch twice.
objection: Two founders and no club running on it yet. If one of them gets sick or quits, we're stuck in the middle of the season. And I don't see anything about handicaps or a link with GOLF.NL. Members already book and pay there for free, so I'd have to explain to the board why they need another app.
would_change_my_mind: Golfclub Zwolle running on it for a full season, with their board telling me on the phone that members actually use it and that it works with GOLF.NL and handicaps.
